ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white) localized clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous region across central and proximal lobes; high-contrast white geometric clusters (irregular blobs) located at the terminal left and right distal tips; sparse, circular high-intensity rings (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly across the central-mid lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with interior pixel angle of approximately 65-75 degrees; base of the notch is partially obscured by water-surface pixel noise.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with an irregular sawtooth profile; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 15 pixels in depth relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High spatial density of roughly circular, white-on-black pixel rings (rosettes) varying in diameter from 5 to 25 pixels, scattered across both lobes with highest concentration on the right lobe medial section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the left lobe, though low contrast makes distinct coordinate mapping difficult.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast white scarring and calcified clusters (barnacle colonization zones) at the extreme lateral edges of both the left and right fluke lobes.
